title: Fallout 4
synopsis: Fallout 4 as a Steam digital holding — mid-sequence on this Fallout shelf, kept for continuity of the series in account custody.

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · no physical counterpart on the shelf
custody.condition: The archive’s copy exists only as a Steam license. Condition concerns are those of the account and client, not of a disc or case.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Fallout 4’s place between New Vegas and Fallout 76 on this shelf.
collectionNotes: Digital ownership confirmed via Steam. No physical edition, booklet, or insert is held. Official cover artwork has been entered; collection photography of a physical object is not applicable.

preservation.playableOn: Archive Steam client on Windows PC
preservation.compatibility: The retained path of access is the Steam license attached to the archive account.
preservation.concerns: Storefront and account dependency remain the central preservation risks. No separate offline media was acquired with this filing.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated November 10, 2015. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Held on the archive Steam account; access lasts only as long as that custody and Steam’s service for the title.
